name: paradise-insti-crm-seed
description: Build and load scripts for the Paradise institutional sales CRM. Every .js file here talks to Firestore through firebase-admin, so the dependency is declared HERE rather than left to be installed by hand. It was missing until 23-Oct-26, which made every script in this folder fail with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a fresh clone - including load_seed.js, the one that puts the DCR into the database.
